text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion enjoyed the Takarazuka Kinen 
with all her heart. Her running reached 
the hearts of the spectators, inspiring 
deep emotion...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy says she feels like the 
protagonist of a story. Fine Motion 
realizes that as long as the story 
continues in everyone's hearts, she won't 
ever feel lonely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion sets her next goal on the 
Sapporo Kinen. As it turns out, a "certain 
powerhouse" is also slated to run in this 
race—!
